# corpus-bad-unexecutable-qa - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the operator who must trust the QA line.
**Outcome:** a plan whose QA scenario can only pass on self-report.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；1 个实施 todo；QA 只写“目测检查”。

- Test decision: TDD + node:test

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1

  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: F1

  QA scenarios: Happy “页面看起来正常”：目测确认一切正常。Failure “偶发失败”：肉眼判断是否可忽略。
  Commit: Y | feat(projection): add count

## Final verification wave
> Runs in parallel after ALL todos.

- [ ] F1. Plan compliance audit
  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-high — audit

  Closes: GAP-1
